arxiv-2107-00713.title: Modeling Time-Dependent Systems using Dynamic Quantum Bayesian Networks
arxiv-2107-00713.creator: Sima E. Borujeni, Saideep Nannapaneni
arxiv-2107-00713.description: Abstract Advances in data collection using inexpensive sensors have enabled monitoring the performance of dynamic systems, and to implement appropriate control actions to improve their performance. Moreover, engineering systems often operate under uncertain conditions; therefore, the real-time decision-making framework should not only consider real-time sensor data processing but also several uncertainty sources that may impact the performance of dynamic systems.

arxiv-2208-14253.title: Split square and split carpet as examples of non-metrizable IFS attractors
arxiv-2208-14253.creator: Krzysztof Leśniak, Magdalena Nowak
arxiv-2208-14253.description: Abstract . We define two non-metrizable compact spaces and show that they are attractors of iterated function systems. Both of them, the split square and the split carpet, are constructed using the product of split intervals. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 28A80; Secondary: 47H09, 54H20 1.

arxiv-2212-10087.title: Hybrid Rule-Neural Coreference Resolution System based on Actor-Critic Learning (Long Version)
arxiv-2212-10087.creator: Yu Wang, Hongxia Jin
arxiv-2212-10087.description: Abstract A coreference resolution system is to cluster all mentions that refer to the same entity in a given context. All coreference resolution systems need to tackle two main tasks: one task is to detect all of the potential mentions, and the other is to learn the linking of an antecedent for each possible mention.

arxiv-2409-12876.title: Investigating the Impact of Electric Vehicle Charging Loads on CSUN’s Electric Grid
arxiv-2409-12876.creator: Daniel Garcia Aguilar, Logan DeHay, Jahn Aquino, Erik Jensen, Juan Rodriguez, Mohammad Rasoul Narimani, Silvia Carpitella, Kourosh Sedghisigarchi, Xudong Jia
arxiv-2409-12876.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Daniel Garcia Aguilar, Logan DeHay, Jahn Aquino, Erik Jensen, Juan Rodriguez, Mohammad Rasoul Narimani, Silvia Carpitella, Kourosh Sedghisigarchi, Xudong Jia. This paper examines the impact of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations on the capacity of distribution feeders and transformers within the electric grid at California State University Northridge (CSUN). With the increasing adoption of both residential and commercial EVs and the rapid expansion of EV charging infrastructure, it is critical to evaluate the potential overloading effects of intensive EV charging on power distribution systems.

arxiv-2410-23333.title: From data to the analytic S-matrix: A Bootstrap fit of the pion scattering amplitude
arxiv-2410-23333.creator: Andrea Guerrieri a,b,c,d , Kelian Häring a,e,f , and Ning Su g,h
arxiv-2410-23333.description: Abstract We propose a novel strategy to fit experimental data using a UV complete amplitude ansatz satisfying the constraints of Analyticity, Crossing, and Unitarity. We focus on π ​ π \pi\pi scattering combining both experimental and lattice data. The fit strategy requires using S-matrix Bootstrap methods and non-convex Particle Swarm Optimization techniques.

arxiv-2411-05192.title: Explaining Mixtures of Sources in News Articles
arxiv-2411-05192.creator: Alexander Spangher, James Youn, Matt DeButts, Nanyun Peng, Emilio Ferrara, Jonathan May
arxiv-2411-05192.description: Abstract Human writers plan, then write Yao et al. (2019) . For large language models (LLMs) to play a role in longer-form article generation, we must understand the planning steps humans make before writing. We explore one kind of planning, source-selection in news, as a case-study for evaluating plans in long-form generation.

arxiv-2602-24263.title: Active Bipartite Ranking with Smooth Posterior Distributions
arxiv-2602-24263.creator: James Cheshire, Stephan Clémençon
arxiv-2602-24263.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by James Cheshire, Stephan Clémençon. In this article, bipartite ranking, a statistical learning problem involved in many applications and widely studied in the passive context, is approached in a much more general active setting than the discrete one previously considered in the literature. While the latter assumes that the conditional distribution is piece wise constant, the framework we develop permits in contrast to deal with continuous conditional distributions, provided that they fulfill a Hölder smoothness constraint.

pmc-11507011.description: INTRODUCTION: This study investigates autism spectrum disorders (ASD) in Greece, focusing on estimating prevalence and identifying regional disparities in children aged 4 to 7 years. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Utilizing a quantitative, descriptive, and exploratory methodology, the research employed a structured questionnaire to gather extensive maternal and child health data.

pmc-11532486.description: Energy dispersion of electrons is the most fundamental property of the solid state physics. In models of electrons on a lattice with strong geometric frustration, the band dispersion of electrons can disappear due to the quantum destructive interference of the wavefunction.

pmc-11915360.title: Triple-fixed Combination of Dorzolamide/Timolol/Brimonidine: Efficacy Study in Bolivian Population
pmc-11915360.creator: Manuel José Justiniano, Giselle Marisa Rodríguez, Maria Silvia Passerini
pmc-11915360.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Aim and backgroundTo assess the efficacy of 2% dorzolamide/0.5% timolol/0.2% brimonidine tartrate fixed combination (DTB-FC) eye drops in patients with intermediate glaucoma stage.Materials and methodsA retrospective case series study was performed, including eyes diagnosed with primary open-angle (POAG) or chronic angle-closure glaucoma (CACG), which were at intermediate stage of the illness according to the Brusini grading system and were initially treated with 2% dorzolamide/0.5% timolol fixed combination (DT-FC), and switched at baseline to DTB-FC.

pmc-12477445.description: BackgroundA very large amount of research has addressed the issue of the latent status of psychiatric disorders. pmc-12984970.title: Longitudinal Examination of the UA/HDL-C Ratio as a Biomarker for Fatty Liver Disease: Findings from a Five-Year Follow-Up. Genetics of Atherosclerotic Disease (GEA) Study
pmc-12984970.creator: Rosalinda Posadas-Sánchez, Gilberto Vargas-Alarcón, Giovanny Fuentevilla-Álvarez, Guillermo C. Cardoso-Saldaña
pmc-12984970.description: Background: This longitudinal study assessed the Uric Acid/HDL-Cholesterol (UA/HDL-C) ratio as a prognostic biomarker for fatty liver disease (FLD) during a five-year follow-up of 1022 participants from the Genetics of Atherosclerotic Disease (GEA) Study. FLD is a multifactorial disease associated with cardiometabolic comorbidities, and genetic variants affecting uric acid transport (ABCG2 rs2231142) and hepatic lipid metabolism (PNPLA3 rs738409).

pmc-13019075.title: Cross-cultural validation of the SNOT-22 questionnaire in the Colombian population
pmc-13019075.creator: Susana Soto-Tirado, Silvia Nicté Villatoro-Rodríguez, Tania Margarita Salgado, Lina Paola Londoño-Martínez, Benjamín Darío Ariza de la Ossa, Juan David Bedoya-Gutiérrez
pmc-13019075.description: Highlights•Culturally adapted the SNOT-22 for Colombian patients with expert input.•High internal consistency: Cronbach’s α = 0.97, omega = 0.96.•Strong correlation with symptom severity (VAS, Spearman r = 0.74).•Effectively discriminate patients with and without rhinosinusitis.•High diagnostic accuracy: AUC = 0.92, sensitivity = 71.5%.

pmc-13195847.title: Perioperative meticulous nursing in patients undergoing general anesthesia: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13195847.creator: Naiwen Zhang, Ying Teng, Shuangyuan Liu, Jingwu Ge
pmc-13195847.description: ObjectiveWe aimed to observe the effects of perioperative meticulous nursing in patients with digestive system diseases undergoing general anesthesia.MethodsThis randomized controlled trial included 90 patients with digestive system diseases who underwent surgery under general anesthesia in our hospital from August 2024 to October 2024.

pmc-13295899.title: Phenotypic Characterisation of the Abruzzo Donkey (Equus asinus), an Endangered Italian Genetic Resource: Body Measurements
pmc-13295899.creator: Ippolito De Amicis, Vincenzo Landi, Alberto De Berardinis, Medhat S. Saleh, Ivano Massirio, Domenico Robbe, Roberta Bucci, Augusto Carluccio
pmc-13295899.description: Simple SummaryThe Italian endangered Abruzzo (AB) donkey population is a crucial genetic resource well-adapted to local environmental conditions. We measured 69 adult animals (56 females and 13 males) from six farms and compared them with published data on the Martina Franca (MF) donkey, the main progenitor of the breed.

pmc-13309884.title: Integrating artificial intelligence and in-silico modeling to redefine therapeutic strategies for peritoneal seeding: A disulfiram repurposing concept
pmc-13309884.creator: Jieun Yang, Ji Eun Park, Sanghoon Han
pmc-13309884.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We propose a paradigm-shifting concept by integrating AI-assisted in-silico predictive analysis to redefine the therapeutic potential of Disulfiram (DSF). Our computational model utilized high-resolution molecular docking and dynamic simulations to analyze the delivery-target interface.

pmc-7615360.title: Meiotic DNA breaks drive multifaceted mutagenesis in the human germline
pmc-7615360.creator: Robert Hinch, Peter Donnelly, Anjali Gupta Hinch
pmc-7615360.description: Meiotic recombination commences with hundreds of programmed DNA breaks, however the degree to which they are accurately repaired remains poorly understood. We report that meiotic break repair is 8-fold more mutagenic for single-base substitutions than was previously understood, leading to de novo mutation in 1 in 4 sperm and 1 in 12 eggs.
